description: Parse timestamps, handle missing end times, and investigate negative durations before aggregation. Train data contains pre-computed processing_time_hours with negative values (min=-7150 hours in one group). Parse both timestamps, exclude or label incomplete records, and check for negative durations.

Check key coverage and cardinality before merging tables to avoid row multiplication and biased aggregates. Train data has 5 join patterns; coverage varies from 0.5 to 1.0. Check join-key coverage, duplicate keys, and row counts before and after the merge.
